heading: Monday, May 19, 2025
topLine: FutureHouse's Robin agents nominate ripasudil for dry macular degeneration, supported in cell assays.

items.headline: FutureHouse's Robin agents nominate ripasudil for dry macular degeneration, supported in cell assays
items.summary: FutureHouse's multi-agent system Robin proposed enhancing retinal pigment epithelium phagocytosis as a strategy for dry age-related macular degeneration, a condition with almost no treatments, and identified the glaucoma drug ripasudil, which increased phagocytosis in human-run experiments whose analysis Robin also performed. Reported as an arXiv preprint; the evidence is in vitro only, and Robin's reported effect size (7.5-fold) was larger than a human re-analysis of the same data (1.75-fold).
